mensajes.asunto: Free clip from your latest episode
mensajes.texto:
Hi Debbie,

I came across "Why Your Coaching Offer Isn't Selling (It's Not Your Niche!)". That title alone is a hook, and there are several 30-second answers inside the episode that could each be a Reel.

I run Hook House, a small editing studio that turns weekly video episodes into short vertical clips: strongest line first, word-by-word captions, zooms, for Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts.

If you already have someone clipping your episodes, please ignore this. If not, I'd like to edit one clip from that episode for free so you can judge the quality. Shall I send it?

[Your name]
Hook House
